    data = input().split()
    if not data:
        return

    N = int(data[0])

    P = [0.0] * N
    C = [0.0] * N
    idx = 2
    for i in range(N):
        P[i] = float(data[idx])
        C[i] = float(data[idx + 1])
        idx += 2

            cost = dp[i] + (dist * dist) / C[i]
